_comment: First half of a chained pair for docs/components/episode-lifecycle.md — the `superseded` close trigger. A task; the agent asks a clarifying question and stops, so the episode opens and stays OPEN with an unfinished plan. episode-supersede-followup then submits an unrelated task, which the classifier should mark continues_prior=false → OpenEpisode closes THIS episode as superseded (recording it, outcome=failure) and opens a fresh one. Run back-to-back, same session key, within idleTTL.

message.content: Migrate the user-profile table from MySQL to Postgres, including the app's data-access layer. What's the first thing you need from me?
